title: Builder Withdrawal Notice and Refund Periods for Homesite Reservations
content:
When Calloway withdraws a reserved homesite from sale, two periods govern a Homesite Reservation: the written notice Calloway gives the buyer before the withdrawal, and the time within which every dollar held is refunded. Both are set by premium class.

| Premium class | Written notice before withdrawal (calendar days) | Refund of every dollar held after withdrawal (business days) |
|---|---|---|
| Interior Homesite | 2 | 5 |
| Corner Homesite | 2 | 5 |
| Cul-de-Sac Homesite | 2 | 5 |
| Greenbelt Homesite | 3 | 5 |
| Water-View Homesite | 3 | 5 |
| Golf-Frontage Homesite | 3 | 5 |

The notice figure is in calendar days; the refund figure is in business days (Monday to Friday, excluding Calloway holidays).
